audit.whatIsWrong: Chart rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 disagreed with the packet and the mirror in both layers.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Renekton x6 then Swain, and the mirror flipped 'Levels 1, 4-5 and 6 to Renekton, and 2+ items to Swain (3/10)' — the exact same four rows. This page's own prose already agreed: content.early 'Renekton owns you at level 1 through 3', content.mid 'Levels 4 through 6 are Renekton's strongest window', whys[6] and spikes[3] both give two items to Swain outright. Rows 1, 2 and 5 already read Renekton.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 to Renekton and row 6 to Swain in both layers as one atomic group. Row 6 rated 7/10, the inverse of the mirror's 3/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three of the four phase whys were pure boilerplate, and phases[4].why claimed 'Demonic Ascension turns his all-in into your healing' at level 6 — the stage the rest of the page correctly calls Renekton's peak.
audit.why: Dominus grants bonus Health, damages everything around him, and generates Fury periodically — so at 6 his empowered abilities come faster, not slower. content.mid says so in plain words ('his level 6 Dominus is the single scariest moment in the lane') while the full layer said the opposite. Levels 4-5 are his because Fury is online, the empowered stun is 1.5s, and empowered Slice and Dice shreds armour.
audit.corrected: phases[0], [3], [4] and [6] rewritten around real mechanics and the correct owner.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ruthless Predator is described only as 'Empowered = long stun' in three fields. Neither stun duration, the Fury threshold, the auto-reset, nor the shield destruction appears anywhere on the page.
audit.why: Riot's W text is unusually specific and every number in it matters: base is two slashes and a 0.75s stun; above 50 Fury it is three slashes, high damage, DESTROYS DAMAGE SHIELDS on the target, and stuns for 1.5 seconds. Cooldown 16/14/12/10/8s. It also carries the autoReset flag — the missing-interactions file flags this as the burst tell, and it is the reason the damage arrives a beat before the player expects. Doubling the stun at a Fury threshold is the single fact that decides whether a trade is survivable, and 'long stun' does not convey it.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d, breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t now carry the threshold, both durations, the reset and the shield strip.

audit.whatIsWrong: content.early says his 'Ruthless Predator empowered W stun fires faster than your E animation' at level 1.
audit.why: Empowered Ruthless Predator requires more than 50 Fury, which he does not have at level 1 — and most Renektons do not have W at level 1 at all. The real reason the level-1 walk-up loses is simpler and true at every rank: W resets his auto-attack, so the burst lands a beat early. Presenting the empowered version as a level-1 threat teaches the player to fear the wrong thing at the wrong time.
audit.corrected: content.early rewritten around the auto reset instead of a level-1 empowered stun.
sources: packet.suspectNames (name itself is a false positive)

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears in the itemization line and in breakdown.late but never in the Do's or Don'ts, and Cull the Meek's cooldown is nowhere.
audit.why: Cull the Meek is a flat 7s at every rank, 325 range, and heals off every target hit — meaning he heals off the whole wave, not off you, which is why poking him down through a big wave does not work. Reign of Anger also generates Fury faster the LOWER his health is, so the moment he looks finishable is the moment his empowered abilities come online.
audit.corrected: dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[2].d now state both.
sources: enemyKit P and Q text and cd

audit.whatIsWrong: content.late hardcodes 'the 53% winrate reflects exactly this'.
audit.why: A win rate quoted inside prose goes stale on the next patch and nothing in the pipeline will catch it, because every checker reads the data field rather than the sentence. The claim works just as well without the number.
audit.corrected: Replaced with a reference to the matchup record.

edits.before: Renekton owns you at level 1 through 3 in a way that demands genuine respect, not optimism. His Ruthless Predator empowered W stun fires faster than your E animation, which means if you try to root him mid-trade he can interrupt your whole setup and leave you drained with no soul fragment. Play level 1 entirely from Q range — hit him with Death's Hand cones when he steps up to last-hit and back off immediately; never auto-attack into his Cull the Meek healing window. At level 2 you have E, but use it only when his W is visibly on cooldown: one E into pull into Q burst is a real trade, but the moment Ruthless Predator is back up he flips the exchange. By level 3 your full kit is online and you can poke with Vision of Empire to slow him, then fish for E when he walks through it — but he still wins a flat all-in at this stage, so keep the wave near your tower and make him come to you.
edits.after: Renekton owns you at level 1 through 3 in a way that demands genuine respect, not optimism. Ruthless Predator resets his auto-attack, so the damage lands a beat before you expect it — step in to root him mid-trade and he interrupts your setup and leaves you with no soul fragment. At level 2 you have E, but use it only when his W is visibly on cooldown: one E into pull into Q burst is a real trade, but the moment Ruthless Predator is back up he flips the exchange. By level 3 your full kit is online and you can poke with Vision of Empire to slow him, then fish for E when he walks through it — but he still wins a flat all-in at this stage, so keep the wave near your tower and make him come to you.

edits.before: Once you complete your first item Renekton has nothing left to threaten you with — his damage falls off sharply past the laning phase, and your W-E-Q burst now threatens a kill if he steps up. Activate Demonic Ascension in any fight he picks and let him drain against your healing; at 2+ items and a healthy fragment count your max HP pool combined with near-permanent R uptime makes you genuinely unkillable in a straight 1v1. Push for objectives and sidelane assignments where you can drain and collect — Renekton cannot duel you here, and the 53% winrate reflects exactly this: survive the brutal early, hit first item, and the lane becomes yours permanently.
